units.source_text: 如果这超出常规的四十个小时是名人方面提出的条件，那么名人自身就背上了沉重的包袱。

en.t: If these forty hours beyond the usual limit were a condition proposed by the Meijin's side, then the Meijin himself had taken on a heavy burden.

units.source_text: 这就是说，名人最后只好强忍病痛的折磨，耐心等待对手的长考。

en.t: In other words, in the end the Meijin had no choice but to endure the torment of his illness and patiently wait through his opponent's long deliberations.

units.source_text: 大竹七段用时三十四个多小时，就说明名人咎由自取了。

en.t: The fact that Otake 7-dan used more than thirty-four hours showed that the Meijin had brought this on himself.
